decisions.reason: As a close extension of the core cheese range that was still given its own page after launch, it likely benefits from moderate sunk-cost and assortment-logic commitment, so management would be inclined to retain it unless clear persistent underperformance became undeniable.

Because it is a product line with several models and was presented separately, the firm has invested more visibly and broadly in it, which under escalation of commitment makes management especially likely to continue supporting it.

The product was explicitly highlighted at launch and later promoted on its own page, suggesting a meaningful public commitment that would make management reluctant to reverse course while market conditions in the industry remain generally favorable.
